summary: Round 1's blocking F2 (rule 6 against §13) and F3 (a scheduled job's cron never registers) are resolved, and F1's sidecar choice is now on the page with correct facts. But option (a), Claude's lean, says the missing podYaml templates affect only the guide's reference files; they also fail the first build of P8's guide-conformant AaC/PipelinesDeploy producer, which V14 requires to be green.
